items.q: What is the Mars vs Chengdu metro gag actually saying?
items.a: **Same year, not the same planet.** Musk sells Mars 2026. The city sells a metro in 2026. Bitcoin vs Q-coin and 5G vs 4G ('faster, more expensive') are the same [[mars-metro-gap]].

items.q: Did tech make his life easier?
items.a: No. **Busier.** He cannot name what 5G changed. He can name what the phone now demands.

items.q: What is the only move that works on robot CS?
items.a: Ignore the menu. Shout **人工** until transfer, or tap 投诉. He will let AI take '废物' jobs first. **Do not take CS.**

items.q: Why would he upload a nude ID selfie if the QR asked?
items.a: **Herd 同意.** Dinner already wants a phone number. The room agreed, so he agrees. The next ask can be worse and still get a tap.
Screens get **sharper**. Faces in life get **blurrier**. Robot dinner raises speed and cuts distance. [[screen-sharp-life-blur]].

items.q: What is the real cost in the clip, not the 流畅播 joke?
items.a: Someone **AI-swapped his face** onto adult content (as the woman). Copy-upload plus 国产自拍. He is the 韭菜. Ng's NCII line is the policy; this is the receipt.
